summary: Comprehensive testing of EzHome backend (21 pytest cases) + frontend (homepage, theme, search, category, newsletter popup, admin login). 100% backend pass. Frontend critical flows all working.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to lifespan context manager.
server.py is 387 lines and embeds 34-product seed list inline; extract seed data to a separate /app/backend/seed_data.py module for maintainability.
_serialize_product_doc helper is defined but never used — dead code.
Admin auth uses a static shared token from env (no per-user, no rotation, no expiry). Acceptable for MVP but document/limit scope.
Newsletter endpoint returns 200 even on duplicate; consider 200 vs 409 semantics, but current behavior is acceptable.
/api/click/{id} uses an unbounded $inc; for production scale consider rate-limiting or bot filtering on click tracking.
